notes.title: Golden Moon Update v1.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes: (Thanks Egyptian-Enthusiast!)

 Added chase timer reset after 8 seconds for A.I. getting stuck in a positive chase loop-
 Removed Elevator damage bug- (Caused by crush plane underneath elevator being lifted by the doors)


Overworld:

 General Lighting Improvements-
 Added Smoke to generators and improved campsite dialogue timing-


Underworld:

 General Lighting Improvements-
 Removed "invisawalls" previously forcing players to take the side-pathways-


Underworld C2

 Fixed Walkway camera collision issue previously causing the player to effectively be "tunneled" 


Underworld FC

 General Lighting Improvements-
 Reduced damage taken from final pit-


Afterlife

 Fixed some sound issues caused by A.I. Anubis setting off traps like the goofball it is-
 General Lighting Improvements-


Afterlife C2

 General Lighting Improvements-
 Added Correct or Incorrect notifs for quiz section-


Ancient Library:

 Elevator damage fix-
 General Lighting Improvements-
 [spoiler] Added Osiris to his rightful place in the Final Treasure Room- [/spoiler]
